speaker: Fishers Guild
text: Fishing is deeply tied to the cultural identity and livelihood of Arcadian fishermen. We depend on conventional bottom-trawling and we have limited economic alternatives — that makes us particularly vulnerable to the disruption this wind park will cause.

speaker: Fishers Guild
text: The underwater structures of the turbines make these fishing grounds unsuitable for bottom-trawling. Other grounds are too far from the coast, and we don't have the means to adapt our techniques to fish in and around the wind park.

speaker: Fishers Guild
text: This project negatively impacts SDGs 1, 2 and 8. It violates our cultural rights and our rights to work and to an adequate standard of living.

speaker: Legal Advisor
text: The rights to work and to an adequate standard of living entail best-efforts obligations. Even so, the measures will make the fishers worse off — and international human rights law formulates a strong presumption against regression.

speaker: Legal Advisor
text: As for their cultural rights, it is debatable whether the use of specific fishing techniques is an intrinsic part of their culture. That is not a settled question.

speaker: Aquanautilus
text: We are not opposed to the project at this location. In fact, it will finally put an end to the destructive bottom-trawling practices of local fishers.

speaker: Aquanautilus
text: We are concerned, however, about the underwater noise and vibrations caused by construction and operation. These can affect the communication, navigation and feeding of marine mammals and fish, and may even lead to habitat displacement.

speaker: Aquanautilus
text: Without mitigating measures, the project will negatively impact SDG 14, and Arcadia will breach its environmental obligations under UNCLOS.

speaker: Legal Advisor
text: Arcadia has an obligation to prevent, reduce and control pollution under Article 194 UNCLOS. The key question is whether underwater noise falls within the definition of pollution under Article 1(1)(4) UNCLOS.

speaker: Legal Advisor
text: If it does, Article 194 requires Arcadia to take measures to prevent, reduce and control that noise and vibration — using the best practicable means at its disposal.
